intro: North Korea has a state-run economy, one of the poorest in Asia, under heavy international sanctions.

chapters.title: How it works
text: Most trade is with China. Coal, minerals and textiles were the main exports before sanctions. Informal markets, called jangmadang, have grown.
The UN says North Korean hackers have stolen billions in cryptocurrency.

chapters.title: Energy
text: Power cuts are common; night satellite photos show the country almost dark.

cardGroups.title: Made in North Korea
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things North Korea makes and sells to the world.
